MEDICARE ADVANTAGE ORGANIZATION DETERMINATION

Date: January 22, 2025
Claim Reference: MA-2025-0041827
Member ID: 1EG4-TE5-MK72
Provider NPI: 1234567890

Dear Provider,

This notice is to inform you that the above-referenced claim has been denied.

Service Denied:
  CPT 96372 — Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular
  CPT J1745 — Infliximab, 10 mg
  Date of Service: 12/15/2024
  Amount Billed: $4,825.00

Reason for Denial:
  CO50 — Non-covered services because these are not deemed medically necessary based on the information submitted.

Explanation: The clinical documentation submitted does not support that the requested infusion therapy (Infliximab) is medically necessary for the diagnosis of M81.0 (Age-related osteoporosis without current pathological fracture). Per NCD 110.12 and LCD L34971, Infliximab is indicated for rheumatoid arthritis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, ankylosing spondylitis, psoriatic arthritis, and plaque psoriasis. The submitted diagnosis of age-related osteoporosis does not meet the coverage criteria for Infliximab under the applicable LCD. The medical record does not document failure, contraindication, or intolerance of FDA-approved osteoporosis treatments (e.g., bisphosphonates, denosumab, raloxifene) that would justify off-label use.

Appeal Rights: You have the right to request a redetermination of this organization determination within 120 calendar days of the date of this notice. To appeal, submit a written request with supporting medical documentation to the address below.

Plan Medical Management
PO Box 30555
Salt Lake City, UT 84130

UNITEDHEALTHCARE
CLAIM DETERMINATION NOTICE

Date: February 3, 2025
Claim Number: UHC-2025-7829134
Subscriber ID: UHC882147563
Provider TIN: 84-5671234
Rendering Provider: Neurology Associates of Metropolis, Dr. Sarah Chen, MD

RE: DENIAL OF CLAIM — PRIOR AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED BUT NOT OBTAINED

Dear Dr. Chen,

UnitedHealthcare has denied the following service(s):

  CPT 70553 — MRI Brain, without contrast, then with contrast, with functional brain MR imaging
  CPT 70551 — MRI Brain, without contrast
  Date of Service: 01/28/2025
  Total Amount: $3,450.00

Denial Reason:
  CO15 — Authorization/pre-certification required. Payment has been denied because the service requires prior authorization, which was not obtained or confirmed prior to the date of service.

Explanation: Per UnitedHealthcare's Imaging Notification Program, advanced imaging services including MRI Brain (CPT 70551, 70553) require prior authorization (notification) before the date of service. UHC did not receive a prior authorization request for the above service(s). While the submitted diagnoses of G43.909 (Migraine, unspecified, not intractable, without status migrainosus) and R51 (Headache) may support the medical necessity of MRI Brain, the claim is denied due to failure to obtain the required prior authorization.

Note: A retrospective authorization may be submitted within 1 business day of an emergency or urgent service. If this service was rendered on an emergency or urgent basis, please submit clinical documentation supporting the emergent/urgent nature of the service along with a retrospective authorization request.

Appeal Instructions: To appeal this determination, submit a written appeal within 180 calendar days of this notice to:

UnitedHealthcare Appeals & Grievances
PO Box 30555
Salt Lake City, UT 84130-0555

Include: (1) prior authorization confirmation number if subsequently obtained; (2) clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity and urgency of the MRI; (3) office notes demonstrating the clinical findings that prompted the imaging order.

AETNA
CLAIM ADJUSTMENT NOTICE

Date: February 10, 2025
Claim ID: AET-2025-3389201
Member: Aetna Member #9214403827
Group: 780210
Provider: Orthopedic Surgery Center, Dr. Michael Torres, MD, NPI 1987654321

NOTICE OF CLAIM DENIAL — CODING ERROR

Services Denied:
  CPT 99214 — Office or other outpatient visit, established patient, moderate medical decision making
  CPT 27447 — Total knee arthroplasty (TKA)
  Date of Service: 02/03/2025
  Billed Amount: $28,647.00

Denial Code: CO16 — Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s).

Specific Errors Identified:
  1. Modifier Missing: CPT 99214 (E/M service) was billed on the same date of service as CPT 27447 (surgical procedure) without modifier -25 (Significant, separately identifiable evaluation and management service by the same physician on the same day of the procedure or other service). Per Aetna Claims Editing Policy and CMS CCI edits, an E/M service billed on the same day as a procedure with a global period requires modifier -25 to indicate that the E/M was a significant, separately identifiable service beyond the pre- and post-operative care included in the surgical global package.

  2. Diagnosis Code Conflict: The primary diagnosis code M17.11 (Primary osteoarthritis, right knee) supports CPT 27447. However, diagnosis code Z96.651 (Presence of right artificial knee joint) is inconsistent with CPT 27447 (total knee arthroplasty) as a primary diagnosis, as Z96.651 indicates a pre-existing prosthesis. If this is a revision arthroplasty, CPT 27448 (Revision total knee arthroplasty) should be billed instead.

Action Required: Submit a corrected claim within 90 days with: (1) modifier -25 appended to CPT 99214; and (2) corrected diagnosis codes reflecting the current clinical condition (initial TKA vs. revision TKA). If the service was a revision, bill CPT 27448 with appropriate diagnosis codes.

Aetna Claims Adjustment Department
PO Box 14079
Lexington, KY 40512-4079

CENTERS FOR MEDICARE & MEDICARE SERVICES
MEDICARE ADVANTAGE ORGANIZATION DETERMINATION

Date: January 15, 2025
Reference Number: MED-2025-1194837
Beneficiary HIC: 1DX8-WR3-KP55
Provider: Oncology Center of Excellence, Dr. James Wright, MD
NPI: 1728394756

DETERMINATION: DENIED — EXPERIMENTAL/INVESTIGATIONAL SERVICE

Service(s) Denied:
  CPT 0481T — Category III code: Molecular profiling procedure, solid tumor neoplasm, next-generation sequencing panel
  CPT 0482T — Category III code: Molecular profiling procedure, hematologic neoplasm
  Date of Service: 01/08/2025
  Billed Amount: $5,200.00

Denial Code: CO42 — Services denied because this procedure/code is not payable per the applicable coverage policy.

Explanation: The requested molecular profiling services (CPT 0481T, 0482T) are classified as Category III CPT codes, which by AMA CPT designation represent emerging technologies, services, and procedures. Per NCD 110.12 (Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) for Medicare Beneficiaries with Germline (Hereditary) Diseases) and NCD 90.2 (National Coverage Determination for NGS for Somatic (Acquired) Conditions), NGS-based molecular profiling is covered only when: (1) the patient has a diagnosis of cancer confirmed by pathology; (2) the test is FDA-approved or approved as a companion diagnostic; (3) the results will be used to guide targeted therapy with an FDA-approved treatment; and (4) the patient has not been previously tested with the same NGS panel for the same condition. The submitted claim does not demonstrate that CPT 0481T/0482T meets all four NCD criteria. Specifically, the documentation does not confirm that the NGS panel is FDA-approved or that the results will guide an FDA-approved targeted therapy for the submitted diagnosis of C34.90 (Malignant neoplasm of unspecified part of unspecified bronchus and lung).

Appeal Rights: You may request a redetermination within 120 calendar days. Submit supporting evidence including: (1) FDA approval or clearance documentation for the specific NGS panel and indication; (2) peer-reviewed literature demonstrating clinical utility; (3) documentation that the results will guide FDA-approved targeted therapy; and (4) the treating oncologist's letter of medical necessity.

Medicare Advantage Plan
Medical Management Department
PO Box 91118
Seattle, WA 98111-1118

AETNA HEALTH INC.
CLAIM DENIAL NOTICE

Date: February 18, 2025
Claim Reference: AET-2025-5902138
Subscriber: Member #7129384560
Plan Type: Aetna Health Network Option (HNO)
Provider: Out-of-Network Emergency Medicine Group, Dr. Lisa Patel, DO
NPI: 1654320987
Facility: Metro General Hospital (Out-of-Network)

DENIAL — OUT-OF-Network SERVICE NOT COVERED

Service(s) Denied:
  CPT 99285 — Emergency department visit, problem of high severity and threat to life function requiring immediate intervention
  CPT 99284 — Emergency department visit, problem of high severity requiring urgent intervention by the ED physician
  Date of Service: 02/11/2025 (Emergency presentation at 23:47)
  Billed Amount: $2,180.00

Denial Code: PR96 — Patient is not covered for this service/procedure. Non-covered charges.

Explanation: The above emergency department services were rendered at Metro General Hospital, which is not a participating provider in the Aetna Health Network Option (HNO) plan. The HNO plan does not provide out-of-network benefits except for emergency services as defined by the prudent layperson standard (42 CFR § 422.113). While the submitted diagnoses of R07.9 (Chest pain, unspecified) and I21.3 (Acute transmural myocardial infarction of unspecified site) may indicate an emergency condition, the plan has determined that the patient's clinical presentation at the time of arrival did not meet the prudent layperson standard for an emergency medical condition as defined under the plan. Specifically, the triage assessment documented the patient as 'stable, ambulatory, chest pain x 3 days, worsening today' — the 3-day duration and ambulatory status suggest a non-emergency presentation that should have been directed to an in-network urgent care or provider office.

Important: If you believe this service qualifies as an emergency under the prudent layperson standard, you may appeal this determination. Per the No Surprises Act (effective 01/01/2022), you may also be entitled to independent dispute resolution (IDR) for this out-of-network emergency service.

Appeal Instructions: Submit a written appeal within 60 calendar days to:

Aetna Appeals & Grievances
PO Box 14079
Lexington, KY 40512-4079

Include: (1) complete emergency department records documenting the clinical presentation, triage assessment, and medical decision making; (2) documentation supporting that a prudent layperson would believe the condition constituted an emergency; (3) evidence that no in-network emergency facility was available within the plan's access standards at the time of presentation.
